verdict.rationale: The Unternehmensregister's own page says publication and deposit orders (e.g., filing of accounting documents) can be submitted online through its Publikations-Plattform. That is a genuine online filing path, but only a single thin mention. The rest of the evidence describes search and retrieval of register entries, and nothing shows a founder can complete the commercial-register entry itself or pay online. missing for 10: online submission of the actual Handelsregister registration, documented end-to-end filing and payment flow, any hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, the core transaction this service exists for (form, register, apply, file, or pay) can be completed online, per the service's own published pages

citations.quote: Wenn Sie eine Veröffentlichung oder Hinterlegung im Unternehmensregister vornehmen möchten, können Sie über die Publikations-Plattform einen entsprechenden Auftrag übermitteln.
